svg.title: Red Breach onboarding route graph, revision 04
svg.text: RED BREACH / ONBOARDING — REVISION 04, STAGE 1: THE JOURNEY
Walked centreline only. Bends are chosen from a vocabulary — corner, dogleg, chamfer, switchback, jink, room crossing — rather than one repeated S-bend.
Gold = entry level (0.00). Blue = working level (-5.00). Everything on the plan is a symbol; the legend below says what each one is.
pipe bay: ceiling drops, service run crosses overhead
junction chamber: railing, step down, three ways out
PUMP ROOM, entered at a corner: three pumps, walkway, two doors
long bay, floor grating — the first place you can see any distance
PLANT ROOM: in one door, down its internal steps, out the far side
narrow squeeze between two equipment banks
junction with nothing in it, three ways out
SWITCH ROOM: cabinets both sides, steps up through the middle
service crossing — equipment leaves one lane open
SWITCHGEAR ROOM: walk in level, leave down the far corner steps
machinery crossing: step up, cross, step down
grille floor over a service void
PUMP GALLERY: cross it on a walkway, steps at the far end
lobby hub: four ways, all of them go somewhere
second approach into the lock lobby
